title: Should `merge --release-check` also refuse a filtered tail, like --lane-lint and --review-record?
why: Question from lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, relayed by the coordinator 12:37 CST Nov 13: out of that lane's scope.
note: Todo, the rest of step bg-tail-loses-verdict. `merge --lane-lint` and `merge --review-record` refuse a filtered tail (a verdict cut off by a pipe to tail or head); `merge --release-check` does not. Decide whether it should. A guard or check change: a build lane (test-author, builder, reviewer). Check the refusal list for other merge flags first.
